PDF.js (pdfjs-dist 6.4.299, "legacy" build), Mozilla, Apache License 2.0 (see LICENSE).
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/pdfjs-dist/-/pdfjs-dist-6.4.299.tgz (sha1 4a46f5146ac6505564c1a5d472900be4df8bf628)
Used for the PDF preview so that zoom works the same in every browser and in the Mac app.

Also from that package, unchanged: wasm/ (the JBIG2, JPEG 2000 and color decoders that scanned and OCR'd
PDFs need; their licenses are beside them), cmaps/, standard_fonts/ and iccs/.
